title: Closed source-library fpqc covering-family descent for a local morphism property
statement: Let P be a property of morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is Zariski local on the target, stable under arbitrary base change, and descends along surjective flat quasi-compact morphisms. Let f: Z -> T, let {g_i: T_i -> T} be a family generating a covering sieve of the fpqc topology [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], and for each i let (Z_i, a_i, b_i) be a fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] of f and g_i. If P(b_i) for all i, then P(f).

source.place: of_isPullback_of_ofArrows_mem_fpqcTopology, section Descent, lines 83-136; an already proved specialization of Stacks Descent 02KP

proof.text: Use Zariski locality to restrict to each affine open of T. Refine its fpqc covering sieve by finitely many affine flat covering members and form their finite coproduct. The coproduct is affine and its map to T is surjective, flat and quasi-compact, so P descends along it. Zariski locality on its target checks P after restriction to every coproduct component, where the hypothesis gives it. For a member of the sieve generated by {g_i}, factor it through some g_i; pullback pasting and stability under base change transfer P(b_i) to its pullback. These are exactly the existing proofs of of_isPullback_of_mem_fpqcTopology_of_isAffine, of_isPullback_of_mem_fpqcTopology, and of_isPullback_of_ofArrows_mem_fpqcTopology.
